title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Wednesday, 14 October 2026
description: Humanoid robotics funding and manufacturing deals accelerate as Hyundai and Boston Dynamics prepare to deploy Atlas on car assembly lines, Aldi again tops supermarket price comparisons, Queensland presses ahead with a $545M dam capacity plan and a bulk water price freeze, and a $2B Broadbeach twin-tower project is unveiled. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
